comparison.objective: Roll a mailer end panel and seat two hidden tabs into base holes; candidate separates finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a sprung wall while forming a double crease and blindly inserting two tabs versus bilateral screen grasp, loose-load control, agitation, and support replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Both tabs seated, wall square/flat, no crushing or excess box motion, released stillness versus media recovery, washer retention, no spill, supported screen, clearance, and dwell.
comparison.reason: Both demand bimanual stabilization, but carton folding/tab insertion and selective many-body sifting are meaningfully different. Missing rubric details: none material.
